$Comment: Ultimate laser sight tracer (2026-10-22). Take 2 (playtest: the particle trail looked horrible; attached particles follow the projectile's yaw, not its pitch, so the dashes lay flat): the model itself is the laser, a thin fullbright needle (3 units ~0.05 block, ice-blue edges, pale core; red changed to blue) 7.5 blocks long reaching ahead of the projectile (Aim_Tracer.blockymodel). Fired every 0.11 s at 70 b/s the needles touch end to end into one line. Tune: L in the art (needle length), the texture colours. No light, scale 1.
